title: Screen a triaged story against both gates before it is queued

story.i_want_to: a triaged story that Gate A refuses, or whose predicted touches hit a guarded path, to be escalated instead of queued
story.so_that: no unattended implementation is spent on work the merge gate is certain to refuse

rationale: Design section 5 runs both gates twice; only the merge run exists, so with the driver on, a story predicted to touch the claims path or carrying disagreeing lenses is implemented at roughly USD 10-20 and then refused. The triage run cannot be the full Gate B: it has no repository file list and the trio's touches are a prediction. So it is a screen that can only ADD an escalation on a positive signal, and the merge run stays the gate.

acceptance_criteria.description: An accepted story verdict whose lens verdicts fail GateA.evaluate/1 takes triaged -> escalated over :triage_escalate with Gate A's reasons, and is not queued.
An accepted story verdict without lens_verdicts takes triaged -> escalated with reason gate_a_inputs_missing, and is not queued.
An accepted story verdict with a drafted touch matching a human_paths or effect_paths trigger takes triaged -> escalated naming the path and pattern, and is not queued.
An accepted story verdict with passing lens verdicts and no touch matching a guarded trigger is queued as today, including when touches is absent.
A trigger configuration that cannot be loaded escalates the story rather than queuing it.

test_cases.name: disagreeing lenses escalate at triage
preconditions: story at triaged, accepted triage dispatch
steps: apply a story verdict whose lens verdicts disagree
expected_results: stage escalated, edge triage_escalate, no queued transition

test_cases.name: no lens verdicts escalates
steps: apply a story verdict without lens_verdicts

test_cases.name: predicted claims-path touch escalates
steps: apply a unanimous story verdict with touches [lib/home_care_billing/claims/x.ex]
expected_results: stage escalated naming the file and pattern

test_cases.name: clean verdict is queued with and without touches
steps: apply a unanimous verdict with harmless touches; on a second story apply one with no touches

test_cases.name: unloadable trigger config fails closed
preconditions: trigger config for the repo missing
expected_results: stage escalated, reason names the config error

technical_notes: Route: the 'story' route in lib/loopctl/delivery/triage_verdict.ex:110; the screen runs in the transaction that writes the drafted story

Add GateB.triage_screen/2 (repo_triggers, touches) returning the human_path and effect_path matches only; GateB.evaluate(:triage, ...) is not usable here because it adds stale_trigger and missing_files reasons without repo_files (gate_b.ex:141-160,237-241)
Touches live in draft metadata (triage_verdict.ex:698-707) and are optional on the wire (runner_contract.ex:1326)
non_goals: Does not bind the implementer to the predicted touches; the merge run still gates
